evidence: Tagged with the Utils/log/libs label and introduces the AssertUnreachable() macro in src/util/check.h.
rationale: Introduces AssertUnreachable() in util/check.h to cleanly abort with [[noreturn]] semantics, resolving -Wreturn-type compiler warnings on GCC and clang-cl and preventing undefined behavior from std::unreachable(). The improvement standardizes unreachable branch assertions across the codebase, though it addresses internal diagnostics and compiler warnings rather than runtime defects.
